description: Release Anxiety & Negative Thoughts | Slow Sarod | 1.5 Hours of Indian Classical Music to release anxiety and quiet the thoughts that won't switch off.

When the day leaves your mind racing, let the sarod slow it down. Ninety minutes of deep, resonant sarod in Raga Bageshri — tender, grounding, and unhurried — made to play in the background while you let the tension drain, breathe, and finally set the day's worries down for the night.
No ads breaking the calm. Just continuous Indian classical music to ease anxiety and an overactive mind.
Best for: releasing anxiety · a mind that won't stop · negative thoughts · evening wind-down · letting the day go.
Put it on, let your shoulders drop, and let the anxiety loosen its grip. 🌙
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals, no humming — deep gentle Indian classical sarod in Raga Bageshri, resonant plucked sarod with slow meend glides and grounding low register, soft light tabla, unhurried ~60 BPM, tender settling late-evening character that releases anxiety and quiets a busy mind, seamless loop.
suno_prompt_note: Anxiety/evening = calming, settling — genuinely calm (calm-lane rule, no upbeat/energetic).
